The eye action immediately updates amount and semantics; completed money actions update both balance and activity.

Receipt ID, amount, and recipient are visible before navigation choices.
AgentDemoStatus and CharcoalButton express the transaction result consistently.

Positive receipt feedback is reinforced by the updated Wallet balance and Activity row.
Receipt previews cover both layouts and runtime follows View activity to the persistent record.

runtimeScenarios.testName: every app keeps its root route stable across tab selection
runtimeScenarios.evidence: The executable cross-app route test selects Activity, asserts after one pump that Wallet is painted and exposed as unselected while Activity and its content are selected, and proves that the nested Navigator retains one Page, the same stable root Page key, and the same ModalRoute.

runtimeScenarios.testName: Lumen completes privacy, top-up, and transfer flows
runtimeScenarios.evidence: The executable widget journey covers balance privacy, receive-copy feedback, top-up persistence, transfer recovery and receipt, Activity, Plan, and Profile.

runtimeScenarios.testName: a durable completion replaces the task stack
runtimeScenarios.evidence: The executable route test verifies a task push followed by a sole durable receipt Page that does not expose the completed form through system back.

checks.evidence: CharcoalTabBar atomically commits selected visuals, semantics, and content in the first painted frame on one stable root Route; financial tasks use the nested Navigator, review stages push real CharcoalPageRoutes, system back synchronizes the task owner, and durable receipts replace obsolete form history.
Balance orientation leads Wallet, transaction facts lead money tasks, and Profile now centers privacy and automation decisions.
Copy states the simulated financial effect and never promises an unavailable service; developer rationale was removed from Profile.
Every surface state has compact and standard production previews with fields, rows, and review values allowed to adapt.
Balance visibility, quick actions, fields, segmented amounts, switches, navigation, and back actions have explicit labels and controlled state.
